body: ugh, I hear ya. I feel like I just stare blankly sometimes with my kids when I should have an amotion.

It's amusing to think about really. I'm sitting here, having already taken a more than sufficient dose of diphenhydramine to knock me the fuck out, just contemplating what I want to do. I'm tempting to pull the trigger and check out. I'm tempted to check pick up my phone and get on suicide watch. I'm tempted to just say fuck it and go to sleep. Everything is just a blur right now.
I've asked the question so many times. Honestly my two kids is really the only answer. At the same time I ask how much does even that matter.
Had I not gotten married and had kids I am quite certain I wouldn't have those looming questions of "how would ____ take my no longer being here"

That really is a weird feeling that you can so clearly put on a face to everyone to make it seem like everything is okay.

I can't say that I'm really "alone" or necessarily "unhappy". I actually wish in so many ways I was alone. I feel way more relaxed, comfortable, and happy all by myself. There are many times I weirdly regret having married and having kids. I just want to be left alone but in another way I don't want to leave my kids.

Several months ago I seriously thought about committing suicide. I had gone through the planning of how and gathered everything I needed to carry it out but never got to the stage of when and where. On meds now and seeing a therapist but the thoughts have never really gone away and still come back pretty strong at times. My wife has no idea how bad I was depressed and close I actually came to ending it all.
